title: How to Download Aadhaar Card With Mobile Number (Step-by-Step Guide)
summary: Learn how to download an Aadhaar card using your registered mobile number and OTP through myAadhaar, the Aadhaar App or UMANG.
body_markdown:
Table of Contents


Toggle


### TL;DR


If your mobile number is linked to Aadhaar, you can download your e-Aadhaar through the myAadhaar portal using an OTP sent to that registered number. You can also use the official Aadhaar App or access the Aadhaar service through UMANG. The downloaded file is a digitally signed, password-protected PDF and is a valid form of Aadhaar.


##


What is Aadhaar Card?


Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identification number issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) to eligible residents of India. It is linked to demographic information, such as name, date of birth and address, and biometric information collected during enrolment.


Aadhaar can be used as proof of identity and address for supported services, but it is not proof of Indian citizenship. It also does not automatically replace documents such as a passport, PAN card, voter ID or driving licence, each of which serves a different legal purpose.


### What is e-Aadhaar?


e-Aadhaar is the electronic version of Aadhaar issued by UIDAI. It is digitally signed, password protected and valid like the physical Aadhaar letter or card.


**Key Benefits of e-Aadhaar:**


- Instantly downloadable online
- Accepted as a valid identity proof
- Available anytime through UIDAI
- Can be stored securely on your phone or computer
- Available in regular and masked formats


***Also read:[What is Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AEPS)?](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/what-is-aeps/)***


##


Can You Download an Aadhaar Card Using a Mobile Number?


Yes, you can download your Aadhaar card using your mobile number, but only if your mobile number is registered with UIDAI. The system sends a one‑time password (OTP) to your registered mobile number, which you must enter to access and download your e‑Aadhaar.


***Requirements Before Downloading Aadhaar by Mobile Number***


Before you begin, make sure you have:


- Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), or Virtual ID (VID)
- Registered mobile number linked with Aadhaar
- an active internet connection
- Access to OTP received on your mobile number


**Note:** If the number is no longer active or is not registered with Aadhaar, update it through a current UIDAI-supported method before attempting the OTP-based download.


##


How to Download Aadhaar Card With Mobile Number: Step-by-Step


Here’s a step-by-step guide to download your Aadhaar card using your mobile number:


### **Step 1: Open the Official myAadhaar Download Page**


As the first step, visit the official UIDAI website; open your browser and visit[myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in](https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/) . Make sure you’re on the official government site only.


### **Step 2: Choose Your Aadhaar Identifier**


Select the identifier you want to use. Depending on the options shown, this may be:


- Aadhaar Number (12 digits), OR
- Enrolment ID (EID), OR
- Virtual ID (VID)


Enter the selected number and the security code displayed on the screen.


### **Step 3: Click “Send OTP”**


A six-digit OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number.


**Remember:**


- Keep your phone nearby during the process
- OTP is valid for 10 minutes


### **Step 4: Enter the OTP**


Type the OTP you received via SMS. Check the box “I agree to Terms and Conditions”. Click “Verify and Download”


### **Step 5: Download the e-Aadhaar PDF**


After successful verification, the e-Aadhaar PDF will download to your device. Save it in a secure folder and avoid uploading it to public cloud folders or sending it through untrusted messaging channels.


### **Step 6: Open the Password-Protected PDF**


The e-Aadhaar password is generally formed using the first four letters of your name in capital letters followed by your year of birth in` YYYY` format.


For example, if the name shown on Aadhaar is **Rahul** and the year of birth is **1995** , the password will be: RAHU1995


For a name containing fewer than four letters, use the available letters followed by the birth year. Enter the name exactly as it appears on Aadhaar.


##


**Download Aadhaar Using the Official Aadhaar App**


The mAadhaar application is the official Aadhaar mobile application developed by UIDAI. It allows users to download Aadhaar, manage profiles, generate Virtual IDs, and access Aadhaar-related services directly from their smartphones.


- Install[Aadhaar app from Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.uidai.pehchaan) or Apple App Store
- Open the app → tap “Download Aadhaar”
- Enter your Aadhaar number + OTP sent to the registered mobile
- Download and save directly on your phone


##


How to Download Aadhaar Using the UMANG App


The UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-Age Governance) is an Indian government app that provides users access to multiple public services on a single platform. Users can check EPF details, pay utility bills, access their Aadhaar card, book gas cylinders, apply for certificates, and use healthcare or education services. Developed by the Government of India, UMANG aims to make digital governance simple, secure, and accessible through both mobile and web platforms for citizens across the country.


#### **Pre-Requirements**


- The[UMANG app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.umang.negd.g2c) should be installed on your phone
- Ensure your mobile number is registered with Aadhaar
- Make sure you have an active internet connection


### **Step 1: Download & Open UMANG App**


Download UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) from Google Play Store (Android) or Apple App Store (iPhone). Open the app and login or register with your mobile number.


### **Step 2: Search for Aadhaar Service**


On the UMANG home screen, tap the Search bar. Type “Aadhaar” and search. Select “Aadhaar” from the results.


### **Step 3: Select “Download Aadhaar”**


You will see multiple Aadhaar services listed like download aadhaar, check aadhaar status, verify aadhaar and order aadhaar reprint. Tap on “Download Aadhaar” as the option to download and save your aadhaar card.


### **Step 4: Enter Your Aadhaar Details**


Simply enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, enter the Security Code / Captcha shown on screen and tap “Get OTP”.


### **Step 5: Enter OTP**


A 6-digit OTP will be sent to your Aadhaar-registered mobile number. Enter the OTP in the given field and tap “Submit” or “Verify”.


### **Step 6: Download the PDF**


After successful OTP verification, your Aadhaar will be downloaded as a password-protected PDF. The file will be saved in your phone’s Downloads folder.


### **Step 7: Open the PDF — Enter Password**


To open the downloaded Aadhaar PDF, enter this password: First 4 letters of your NAME (CAPITALS) + Year of Birth.

Aadhaar Download Methods Compared


Method Verification required Best for


myAadhaar portal OTP on the registered mobile number Desktop or mobile-browser users


Aadhaar App Current in-app verification flow Smartphone users who want Aadhaar services in one app


UMANG app OTP on the Aadhaar-registered mobile number Users accessing multiple government services


Aadhaar enrolment or update centre In-person verification where required Mobile updates, biometric changes or assisted support


##


Can You Download Aadhaar Without a Registered Mobile Number?


The myAadhaar and UMANG download flows require access to the Aadhaar-registered mobile number because identity verification is completed through OTP. If you have lost access to that number, update the mobile number using a current UIDAI-supported method before trying again.


The current Aadhaar App supports mobile-number updates for eligible users through its verification flow. If that option is unavailable on your device, or the app cannot complete verification, you can visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra or enrolment and update centre.


##


Where Aadhaar Is Commonly Used


Aadhaar is commonly used for identity verification, direct-benefit schemes, selected financial services, tax-related processes and other public or private services where Aadhaar use is legally permitted and applicable.


The exact requirement depends on the service and governing rules. Aadhaar should not be described as universally mandatory for every bank, SIM, passport, visa, employment or government process. Alternative identity documents may be accepted depending on the purpose.


Aadhaar-based systems also support services such as AEPS, electronic KYC and digital document signing. ##


How to Update the Mobile Number Linked to Aadhaar


If your mobile number is not linked or registered with the Aadhaar card, you cannot link it online. You have to physically visit the nearest official Aadhaar centre, as biometric verification is mandatory in order to link phone number with Aadhaar.


### **Option 1: Update Through the Aadhaar App**


UIDAI’s current[Aadhaar App guidance](https://uidai.gov.in/hi/aadhaar-app-faq) states that mobile-number updates are available directly through the app. The process can involve app registration, identity verification and face authentication. Availability and device requirements may change, so follow the latest in-app instructions.


### Option 2: Visit an Aadhaar Centre


You can also update the number at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra or authorised enrolment and update centre:


1. Locate a nearby centre using UIDAI’s centre locator.
2. Book an appointment if the centre supports advance booking.
3. Visit the centre and request a mobile-number update.
4. Provide the new mobile number and complete the required biometric verification.
5. Pay the applicable UIDAI fee.
6. Collect the acknowledgement slip containing the request number.
7. Track the request through the UIDAI status service.


UIDAI guidance indicates that an old mobile number or supporting document is generally not required for a mobile-number update at a centre. However, carry your Aadhaar number and follow any instructions provided while booking.


Do not rely on a fixed 7–10 day timeline. UIDAI states that most update requests are completed within 30 days, but every request remains subject to verification and validation.


##


Common Aadhaar Download Problems and Solutions


Problem What to do


OTP not received Confirm that the registered number is active, check network availability and try again after a short interval


Aadhaar PDF does not open Recheck the name-and-birth-year password format


Mobile number is not linked Use the Aadhaar App’s update option or visit an authorised Aadhaar centre


UIDAI service is temporarily unavailable Retry later or use another official channel


Details on Aadhaar are incorrect Submit the appropriate update request through UIDAI


Download page looks suspicious Close it and access the service again through the official UIDAI website


##


How to Keep a Downloaded Aadhaar Secure


An Aadhaar PDF contains personal information and should be handled carefully.


- Download it only from official UIDAI or government channels.
- Never share your Aadhaar OTP, even with a customer-support caller.
- Use masked Aadhaar when the full number is not required.
- Avoid posting or emailing an unmasked Aadhaar unnecessarily.
- Store the PDF in a protected folder rather than an open photo gallery.
- Verify why an organisation needs Aadhaar before providing it.


In a masked Aadhaar, the first eight digits are hidden and only the last four digits remain visible. It is useful when a valid Aadhaar document is needed but disclosure of the complete number is unnecessary. Businesses handling Aadhaar copies should also understand[Aadhaar KYC privacy risks](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/privacy-concerns-addressing-aadhaar-card-kyc-security-issues/) and[why Aadhaar masking matters](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/why-is-aadhaar-masking-mandatory-for-businesses/) .


##


Conclusion


Downloading an Aadhaar card with a mobile number is straightforward when that number is registered with Aadhaar. Use the official myAadhaar portal, Aadhaar App or UMANG service, complete the required verification and store the downloaded e-Aadhaar securely.


If you cannot access the registered number, use the mobile-update option currently available in the Aadhaar App or visit an authorised Aadhaar centre. Always verify current instructions and fees through UIDAI because app features, charges and service flows can change.

FAQs


#### **Can I Download an Aadhaar Card Using a Mobile Number OTP?**


Yes. Enter your Aadhaar number, Enrolment ID or Virtual ID on the official download service and verify the request using the OTP sent to the mobile number registered with Aadhaar.


#### **Can I Download an Aadhaar Card Without a Registered Mobile Number?**


You cannot use the myAadhaar or UMANG OTP download flow without access to the registered number. Update the number through a currently supported UIDAI method first.


#### **Can I Download Someone Else’s Aadhaar?**


You should not access or download another person’s Aadhaar without their clear knowledge and authorisation. The OTP is sent to the mobile number registered with that Aadhaar record and should not be requested or shared casually.


#### **What Is a Masked Aadhaar Card?**


In a masked Aadhaar, you can only view the last 4 digits of your Aadhaar number. A masked Aadhaar card replaces 8 out of 12 digits with ‘xxxxx’ or asterisks. There is nothing wrong with masked Aadhaar; it is a valid document used for identification without leading to exposure of the Aadhaar number.


#### **Can I download a masked Aadhaar card?**


Yes. UIDAI allows users to download a masked Aadhaar where only the last four digits of the Aadhaar number are visible.


#### **Is e-Aadhaar valid everywhere?**


Yes. e-Aadhaar is digitally signed by UIDAI and is legally valid wherever a physical Aadhaar card is accepted.
